{{nihongo|'''Amatarashi Shrine'''|雨降神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Awa Province (Tokushima)]].

'''Amatarashi Shrine''' (あまたらしじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Fudō Nishimachi|Q11361655|qid=Q11361655}}, {{ill|Tokushima (city)|Q207309|qid=Q207309}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|Q160734|qid=Q160734}}.

=== History ===
The year of foundation is unknown. It is identified with the Engishiki-listed minor shrine Watatsumi Toyotama-hime Shrine of {{ill|Nakata district|Q3205778|qid=Q3205778}}. Some sources identify it with the Shikinaisha “Ama no Iwato Waketsu Toyotama-hime Shrine.” In the 7th year of {{ill|Gangyō|Q747451|qid=Q747451}} ({{ill|883|Q30355|qid=Q30355}}), it was granted the court rank of {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|Q11071125|qid=Q11071125}} Upper as a {{ill|Shinkai (divine rank)|Q11591025|qid=Q11591025}}. According to the “{{ill|Awa-shi|Q65291985|qid=Q65291985}},” it states: “Amatarashi Shrine—located in Niiminami Village; there is a pond in front; when rain is prayed for, it surely responds.” However, writing “雨降” and reading it as “Amatarashi” is unnatural (it would ordinarily be read as Amakudari), and there is a theory that it was originally a shrine related to {{ill|Prince Ametarashihiko|Q11443593|qid=Q11443593}}, who has the same reading.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* {{ill|Toyotama-hime|qid=Q2329261|lt=Toyotama-hime no Mikoto}}

=== Festivals ===
* {{ill|March 4 (Lunisolar)|Q838975|qid=Q838975|lt=Old March 4}} – Dada Kagura Festival
* {{ill|June 4 (Lunisolar)|Q839676|qid=Q839676|lt=Old June 4}} – Summer Festival
* {{ill|October 23|Q2958|qid=Q2958}} – Annual festival

=== Access ===
* About 2.2 km from {{ill|Akui Station|Q4701935|qid=Q4701935}} on the {{ill|Tokushima Line|Q899310|qid=Q899310}} of {{ill|Shikoku Railway Company|Q496531|qid=Q496531|lt=JR}}.
* From Tokushima City, via {{ill|Tokushima Prefectural Road and Kagawa Prefectural Road Route 1|Q11490196|qid=Q11490196}}, 1 km before (south of) {{ill|Nada Bridge|Q11415515|qid=Q11415515}}, turn west at the intersection in {{ill|Fudō Nishi|Q11361655|qid=Q11361655|lt=Fudō Nishi}} and it is immediately there.
